rca of the issue: USER BUG (Cloudflare 524 on Q2/Q3): The old ask_tutor endpoint used `session_id=f"coach_max_{user_id}_{submission_id}"` — a CONSTANT per (user, submission). LlmChat internally accumulates conversation history under a session_id, so every follow-up call was replaying the ENTIRE prior conversation on TOP OF the freshly-built 15-20K-char system prompt. Q1 prompt ~= 15K chars; Q2 prompt ~= 15K + (Q1 + A1) ~= 20K; Q3 ~= 25K+; by Q3 gpt-5.2 latency exceeded Cloudflare's 100s cap → 524. FIX (server.py ~3882): (a) Fresh unique session_id per request `coach_max_{uuid4.hex[:12]}` — LlmChat starts empty each call, (b) manually load last 6 tutor_chats from Mongo (bounded window via `.to_list(6)`), inject compactly into the prompt (q[:400], a[:800]) so context is preserved WITHOUT compounding, (c) trimmed submission_text/context_text/cumulative_ctx to 2500 each and feedback to 2000, (d) asyncio.wait_for(75s) → HTTP 504 with retry-hint (fires before Cloudflare's 100s cap for clean UX). VERIFIED with 3-sequential-question test: Q1=9.7s, Q2=8.6s, Q3=2.7s (was Q3>>Q1 pre-fix). History-window test with 8 preloaded chats confirms `.to_list(6)` bounds the prompt correctly. All prior test suites pass unchanged.
